questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of food do all captive giant pandas in zoos worldwide consume in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 700 giant pandas in captivity globally.
An adult giant panda eats about 18 kilograms of bamboo and fresh food per day.
700 pandas multiplied by 18 kilograms per day equals 12600 kilograms consumed daily.
12600 kilograms per day multiplied by 365 days gives an annual total of about 4599000 kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total litres of water are contained within all swimming pools at private residential homes across Australia?
reasoning: There are roughly 1.5 million residential swimming pools in Australia.
An average backyard swimming pool holds about 100000 litres of water.
Multiplying 1.5 million pools by an average capacity of 100000 litres per pool results in the total volume.

questions.prompt: How many total individual pages are contained within all passport booklets issued to citizens of Canada currently in active circulation?
reasoning: There are approximately 24 million valid Canadian passports in circulation at any given time.
A standard Canadian passport booklet contains 36 pages.
Multiplying 24 million passports by 36 pages per passport gives the total number of pages in circulation.
